Name: Tile Counter
Author: FawazT
Description:
[color=#cc0000][size=5]Installation[/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to easily change keybinds and settings in-game.[/*]
[/list][color=#cc0000][size=5]Features[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Gamepad support[/*]
[*]Three Scan Modes:
[list]
[*]Area Scan: Select two corners to scan a rectangular area.[/*]
[*]Connected Scan: count all connected tilled soil (perfect for irregular crop layouts).[/*]
[*]Location Scan: Instantly scans the entire map.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Smart Selection: Automatically uses your mouse cursor; if using a gamepad or hiding the mouse, it targets the tile in front of your character.[/*]
[*]Visual Borders: Dynamic, high-quality borders highlight your selection. Includes a "Simple Border" mode for a cleaner look.[/*]
[*]Configurable Toggles: Choose exactly what you want to count:
[list]
[*]Total selected tiles.[/*]
[*]Harvestable crops.[/*]
[*]Dry (unwatered) tilled soil.[/*]
[*]Seedable (empty) tilled soil.[/*]
[*]Diggable (hoeable) tiles.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][color=#cc0000][size=5]Controls[/size][/color]
[color=#ff7700][size=4]Scan Current Location[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]Keyboard: Ctrl + V[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Xbox Gamepad: Y + DPad Right[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Playstation Gamepad: Triangle + DPad Right[/size][/*]
[/list][color=#ff7700][size=4]Scan Connected Soil[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]Keyboard: Ctrl + X[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Xbox Gamepad: Y + DPad Down[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Playstation Gamepad: Triangle + DPad Down[/size][/*]
[/list][color=#ff7700][size=4]Toggle Area Mode[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]Keyboard: Ctrl + C[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Xbox Gamepad: Y + DPad Up[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Playstation Gamepad: Triangle + DPad Up[/size][/*]
[/list][color=#ff7700][size=4]Select Tile[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]Mouse Left Click[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Xbox Gamepad: A[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Playstation Gamepad: Cross[/size][/*]
[/list]Note: Connected Scan requires you to click on a piece of tilled soil to start the scan.

[color=#cc0000][size=5]Configuration[/size][/color]
Using Generic Mod Config Menu, you can:
[list]
[*]Eight-Way Scan: Toggle whether the connected scan checks diagonally or only the four cardinal directions.[/*]
[*]Simple Border: Switch between the decorative textured border and a simple semi-transparent color overlay.[/*]
[*]HUD Settings: Enable or disable specific count notifications to reduce clutter.[/*]
[/list]
